# Khan Academy India

> > Khan Academy India provides free, world-class education aligned with the Indian CBSE/NCERT curriculum across multiple regional languages.

Khan Academy India is a localized educational platform dedicated to serving students across India with comprehensive coverage of the national curriculum. The platform offers content in 8 languages including Hindi, Hinglish, Gujarati, Assamese, Odia, Marathi, Punjabi, and Kannada, making quality education accessible to diverse learners from grades 1-12.

## Key Topics

- CBSE Curriculum
- NCERT Standards
- Multilingual Learning
- Hindi & Regional Languages
- Mathematics & Science
- Teacher Training
- Parent Resources
- Free Education
- Grade 1-12 Coverage
- Foundation Courses
- Khan for Educators
- Interactive Learning
- Personalized Learning Paths
- Student Assessment

## Main Portal

- [Khan Academy India](http://india.khanacademy.org/): Khan Academy India portal offering CBSE/NCERT curriculum in 8 languages including Hindi, Hinglish, Gujarati, Assamese, Odia, Marathi, Punjabi, and Kannada for grades 1-12
